description: Royalty-free and copyright-safe music for videos, streams, podcasts and games.
description_zh: 适合视频、直播、播客与游戏的免版税、无版权风险音乐。

entries.name: YouTube Audio Library
entries.description: Free music and sound effects provided by YouTube for use in your videos.
entries.description_zh: YouTube 官方提供的免费音乐与音效，可用于你的视频。
entries.license: YouTube Audio Library License (some tracks CC-BY)
entries.notes: Some tracks require attribution exactly as shown in the library.
entries.notes_zh: 部分曲目要求按库中说明的方式署名。

entries.name: Pixabay Music
entries.description: Large and growing library of royalty-free tracks and loops.
entries.description_zh: Pixabay 旗下大型免版税音乐与循环素材库。

entries.name: Free Music Archive
entries.description: Archive of Creative Commons music, running since the WFMU radio days.
entries.description_zh: 源自 WFMU 电台的大型知识共享（CC）音乐档案库。
entries.notes: Filter by license; some tracks are NonCommercial or NoDerivatives.
entries.notes_zh: 按许可证筛选；部分曲目仅限非商业或禁止演绎。

entries.name: Incompetech
entries.description: Kevin MacLeod's legendary library of film-score style music.
entries.description_zh: Kevin MacLeod 的传奇影视配乐库。
entries.notes: Credit must be visible: "Track Title" — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0. Monetized videos are explicitly allowed.
entries.notes_zh: 署名必须可见：「曲目名」— Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)，CC BY 4.0；官方明确允许用于已货币化视频。

entries.name: Bensound
entries.description: Catchy corporate, acoustic and cinematic tracks by composer Benjamin Tissot.
entries.description_zh: 作曲人 Benjamin Tissot 的轻快企业风、原声与电影感曲目。
entries.notes: Free license covers online videos with credit; some tracks are Pro-only.
entries.notes_zh: 免费许可覆盖需署名的网络视频；部分曲目仅限 Pro。

entries.name: Mixkit Music
entries.description: Envato's free music for videos, streams and podcasts.
entries.description_zh: Envato 旗下 Mixkit 的免费音乐，可用于视频、直播与播客。

entries.name: Uppbeat
entries.description: Modern royalty-free music made for creators, with a free monthly tier.
entries.description_zh: 面向创作者的现代免版税音乐，含每月免费额度。
entries.notes: Free account has a monthly download cap and requires pasting the credit link.
entries.notes_zh: 免费账户每月下载有上限，且必须粘贴署名链接。

entries.name: Scott Buckley
entries.description: Film-quality orchestral and ambient library released under CC-BY.
entries.description_zh: 以 CC-BY 发布的电影级管弦与氛围音乐库。
entries.notes: Credit Scott Buckley in your video description; missing credits have triggered YouTube copyright claims.
entries.notes_zh: 需在视频简介中署名 Scott Buckley；漏署名可能收到 YouTube 版权申诉。

entries.name: Audionautix
entries.description: Jason Shaw's free rock, acoustic and electronic tracks.
entries.description_zh: Jason Shaw 的免费摇滚、原声与电子音乐。
entries.notes: Commercial use is allowed as long as credit is given to Jason Shaw (audionautix.com).
entries.notes_zh: 允许商用，但必须署名 Jason Shaw（audionautix.com）。

entries.name: Mikael Hellman
entries.description: Cinematic and orchestral instrumentals from a single composer, free under CC BY.
entries.description_zh: 单人作曲家的电影感与管弦乐器乐曲库，以 CC BY 协议免费提供。
entries.notes: Every track is checked by hand against YouTube Content ID, with the date shown on its page; anything registered is removed rather than flagged. Some tracks are AI-assisted, and each page says which.
entries.notes_zh: 每首曲目都经人工核对 YouTube Content ID，页面标明核对日期；一旦发现已被登记即下架，而非仅作标注。部分曲目由 AI 辅助制作，页面均有注明。

entries.name: FreePD
entries.description: Public domain music across many genres, zero restrictions.
entries.description_zh: 覆盖多种流派的公有领域音乐，零限制。

entries.name: Musopen
entries.description: Public domain classical recordings, sheet music and music textbooks.
entries.description_zh: 公有领域古典音乐录音、乐谱与教材。
entries.notes: Most recordings are public domain; verify the license on each item.
entries.notes_zh: 多数录音为公有领域；请逐项核对许可。

entries.name: ccMixter
entries.description: Community remix site with Creative Commons licensed tracks.
entries.description_zh: 社区混音站点，曲目采用 Creative Commons 许可。

entries.name: NoCopyrightSounds (NCS)
entries.description: Iconic electronic music label, free for creators who follow its usage policy.
entries.description_zh: 知名电子音乐厂牌，遵守其使用政策即可免费使用。
entries.notes: Credit the track title, artist and NCS link; policy covers monetized YouTube and Twitch.
entries.notes_zh: 需注明曲名、作者与 NCS 链接；政策覆盖已开通收益的 YouTube 与 Twitch。

entries.name: StreamBeats
entries.description: Harris Heller's copyright-safe music library built specifically for streamers.
entries.description_zh: Harris Heller 为直播主打造的无版权风险音乐库。
entries.notes: Available on major streaming platforms; designed to be DMCA-safe.
entries.notes_zh: 各大音乐平台可听；专为规避 DMCA 设计。

entries.name: Pretzel Rocks
entries.description: DMCA-safe music player for streamers with a free tier.
entries.description_zh: 面向直播主的无版权风险音乐播放器，含免费档。
entries.notes: Free tier requires on-stream attribution; paid tier removes it.
entries.notes_zh: 免费档要求在直播画面署名；付费档可去除。

entries.name: Purple Planet
entries.description: Mood-based free tracks for small creators and non-broadcast use.
entries.description_zh: 按情绪分类的免费曲目，适合小型创作者与非广播用途。
entries.notes: Free for YouTube and online video with credit; other uses need a paid license.
entries.notes_zh: 署名后可免费用于 YouTube 等网络视频；其他用途需购买许可。

entries.name: Chosic
entries.description: Aggregator of free and CC music with handy license filters.
entries.description_zh: 免费与 CC 音乐聚合站，支持按许可证筛选。

entries.name: Thematic
entries.description: Free songs for creators in exchange for a simple credit link.
entries.description_zh: 以署名链接换免费音乐，专为视频/播客创作者设计。
entries.notes: Each track used needs its credit link in your description.
entries.notes_zh: 每首使用的曲目都需按站方要求在简介放置署名链接。

entries.name: Soundimage.org
entries.description: Free music tracks and texture images by Eric Matyas; credit required.
entries.description_zh: Eric Matyas 提供的免费音乐与贴图素材；使用时需署名。
entries.notes: Attribution page requires crediting the author in the game/video/podcast description; tracks are free for commercial projects.
entries.notes_zh: 署名页要求在使用作品的说明中署名；曲目可免费用于商业项目。

entries.name: Ende (formerly Filmmusic.io)
entries.description: Royalty-free production music by Sascha Ende under CC BY 4.0, commercial use included.
entries.description_zh: Sascha Ende 的免版税制作音乐，CC BY 4.0 授权，含商业使用。
entries.notes: Renamed from filmmusic.io. CC BY 4.0 with commercial use allowed; download opens a 'License ticket' step, account requirement unverified.
entries.notes_zh: 由 filmmusic.io 改名而来。CC BY 4.0、允许商用；下载会弹出「License ticket」步骤，是否需要账号未验证。

entries.name: Tunetank
entries.description: Royalty-free music and sound effects for video creators; free tier for commercial projects.
entries.description_zh: 面向视频创作者的免版税音乐与音效；免费档可用于商业项目。
entries.notes: License page allows free commercial use; check each track's terms and be aware channels may need whitelisting to avoid copyright claims.
entries.notes_zh: 许可页允许免费商用；请逐曲确认条款，并注意频道可能需加入白名单以避免版权投诉。
